The frequent re-sampling of the optimal configuration with varying rewards (17.32 to 25.28) suggests significant environmental variability in the benchmark.

The optimal configuration appears to be: `{min_granularity_ns=50000000, latency_ns=50000000, cstate_max=C1, napi_busy_poll=500, wakeup_granularity_ns=50000000, migration_cost_ns=50000000, max_perf_pct=90, min_perf_pct=10}`.

Consider increasing the number of trials for new configurations to account for the observed benchmark variability.
